name: claude-config
description: Plugins from aguiddir's Claude Code setup

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Desktop notification when Claude finishes, fails, or waits for a permission or an answer

plugins.name: replay
plugins.description: /replay, or r after a turn, steps through its file edits as diffs above the prompt

plugins.name: ci-watch
plugins.description: A band above the prompt that follows the Jenkins build of the current branch, stage by stage, with its Sonar quality gate

plugins.name: pr-comments
plugins.description: A pane to work through the review threads of your PRs and the current branch's: hand some to Claude, reply, resolve
